about: chrome-headless-shell builds that setup_renderers.sh accepts without MERMAID_RENDER_BROWSER_SHA256 (TASK 110 R7.3, R7.4). tree_sha256 is the sha256 of one JSON line per entry under the directory that holds the executable, sorted bytewise by path: ["file", "./<path>", "<sha256>"] or ["link", "./<path>", "<target>"], each followed by a newline (setup_renderers.sh read_browser). Chrome for Testing publishes no sha256, so each entry was measured on a build whose renders produced the committed evidence.
